title.zh: “落在这两个值之间”的可能性有多大？

description.en: The normal curve answers almost every “how likely” question about a measurement. Slide the edges, see the area, and read the same number off the table of the paper: forwards for a probability, backwards for a cut-off.
description.zh: 正态曲线几乎能回答所有关于测量值的“有多大可能”的问题。移动两条边，看面积，再从试卷上的那张表里读出同样的数：正着读得概率，倒着读得分界值。

name.en: The normal distribution and the z table
name.zh: 正态分布与 z 表

description.en: Reading a normal probability as the height of the curve
description.zh: 把正态概率当作曲线的高度

description.en: Forgetting that the table gives the area to the left
description.zh: 忘了表给的是左边的面积

description.en: Splitting a negative z into row and column wrongly
description.zh: 把负的 z 拆成行和列时拆错

text.en: A tyre company road-tested its new tyre: the lifetime is normal with mean 36,500 miles and standard deviation 5,000 miles. The curve is a picture of how the lifetimes are spread; the **area** under it between two values is the share of tyres that last that long. The whole area is 1, half lies on each side of the mean.
text.zh: 一家轮胎公司对新轮胎做了路试：寿命服从正态分布，均值 36,500 英里，标准差 5,000 英里。曲线画的是寿命的分布；它在两个值之间的**面积**，就是寿命落在这个范围里的轮胎所占的比例。总面积是 1，均值两边各占一半。

alt.en: A normal curve with draggable edges: the shaded area, the z value and the place in the table update as you move.
alt.zh: 一条可以拖动边的正态曲线：移动时，阴影面积、z 值和它在表里的位置都会更新。

caption.en: Drag the edge of the shaded part. Under the curve: the working in the exam’s own steps. Below: the table, with the cell used.
caption.zh: 拖动阴影的边。曲线下面是按考试步骤写出的算式。再下面是那张表，用到的格子被标出来。

prompt.en: Two tyre makers have the same mean lifetime. The standard deviation is bigger for maker B. Which curve is lower and wider, and which has the larger **area** under it?
prompt.zh: 两家轮胎厂的平均寿命相同。B 厂的标准差更大。哪条曲线更矮更宽？哪条曲线下的**面积**更大？

label.en: B’s curve is lower and wider; both areas are exactly 1.
label.zh: B 的曲线更矮更宽；两个面积都恰好是 1。

label.en: B’s curve is lower, so B’s area is smaller.
label.zh: B 的曲线更矮，所以 B 的面积更小。

feedback.en: Every probability distribution has total area 1; spreading it out lowers it.
feedback.zh: 每个概率分布的总面积都是 1；摊开了，高度就降低了。

label.en: B’s curve is taller and narrower.

feedback.en: Larger $\sigma$ means more spread: wider and lower.

explain.en: A probability is an area, never a height. $\sigma$ sets how wide the same area is spread.
explain.zh: 概率是面积，不是高度。$\sigma$ 决定同样的面积摊得有多宽。

title.en: The standard normal and the table

text.en: There is a different normal curve for every $\mu$ and $\sigma$, but the table covers one: the **standard normal** (mean 0, standard deviation 1). To use it, convert your value into **how many standard deviations from the mean it is**:
text.zh: 每一对 $\mu$ 和 $\sigma$ 都有一条不同的正态曲线，但表只覆盖一条：**标准正态**（均值 0、标准差 1）。要用它，先把你的值换算成**离均值有几个标准差**：

items.en: Split it for the table: the row is the units and tenths ($-1.4$), the column the hundredths (.09). For a negative $z$, use the **negative** page: $-1.49$ is row $-1.4$, column .09.
items.zh: 为查表把它拆开：行是个位和十分位（$-1.4$），列是百分位（.09）。负的 $z$ 要用**负数**那一页：$-1.49$ 是行 $-1.4$、列 .09。

items.en: The entry is the area **to the left** of $z$: $P(Z < z)$.
items.zh: 表里的数是 $z$ **左边**的面积：$P(Z < z)$。

rows.en: a cut-off for a given area $p$ on the left
rows.zh: 左边面积为 $p$ 的分界值

rows.en: find $p$ **inside** the table, read its $z$, then $x = \mu + z\sigma$
rows.zh: 在表**里面**找 $p$，读出它的 $z$，再算 $x = \mu + z\sigma$

text.en: Three landmarks, which you can use without the table: about **68.3%** of values lie within one $\sigma$ of the mean, **95.4%** within two and **99.7%** within three.
text.zh: 三个不用查表的路标：大约 **68.3%** 的值落在均值一个 $\sigma$ 以内，**95.4%** 在两个以内，**99.7%** 在三个以内。

body.en: For a cut-off you search the *body* of the table for the area and read the $z$ from the row and column. If the exact area is not there, take the closest entry (for 0.10 the closest is 0.1003, $z = -1.28$).
body.zh: 求分界值时，要在表的*正文*里找面积，再从行和列读出 $z$。如果没有正好的面积，取最接近的那个（0.10 最接近的是 0.1003，$z = -1.28$）。

prompt.en: With mean 36,500 and standard deviation 5,000, what is the probability that a tyre lasts **more than** 40,000 miles? (Four decimals.)
prompt.zh: 均值 36,500，标准差 5,000，一只轮胎寿命**超过** 40,000 英里的概率是多少？（四位小数）

explain.en: $z = (40{,}000 - 36{,}500)/5{,}000 = 0.70$. The table gives $P(Z < 0.70) = 0.7580$, the area on the left, so the right tail is $1 - 0.7580 = 0.2420$.

prompt.en: The company will refund tyres that fail before a guaranteed mileage, and wants no more than 10% to qualify. What guarantee, in miles?
prompt.zh: 公司会对没有达到保证里程就坏掉的轮胎退款，希望符合条件的不超过 10%。保证里程应该是多少英里？

explain.en: The area on the left is 0.10; the closest table entry is 0.1003, at $z = -1.28$. Then $x = 36{,}500 + (-1.28)(5{,}000) = 30{,}100$ miles.

title.zh: 考试里的版本：维多利亚州的房贷

text.en: Question 5 has two halves. The first half is the normal distribution: four parts, 13 marks. The tool now has the mortgage numbers: change the edge, or switch to “find x from an area” for parts (iii) and (iv).
text.zh: 第 5 题分两半。上半是正态分布：四问，13 分。工具里现在是房贷的数字：改变边的位置，或者切换到“由面积求 x”来做 (iii) 和 (iv)。

title.zh: 第 5 题，正态分布 · 13 分

paras.en: As per the Australian Bureau of Statistics, the average 2018 mortgage sizes in Victoria, Australia is approximately \$409,000. Assume mortgage sizes vary with standard deviations of \$19,500 and that it is normally distributed.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚统计局的数据，2018 年澳大利亚维多利亚州的平均房贷金额约为 \$409,000。假设房贷金额的标准差为 \$19,500，并且服从正态分布。

paras.en: (i) What is the probability that the mortgage size falls below \$380,000? [2 marks]
paras.zh: (i) 房贷金额低于 \$380,000 的概率是多少？[2 分]

paras.en: (ii) What is the probability that the mortgage size fall between \$370,000 and \$450,000? [3 marks]
paras.zh: (ii) 房贷金额在 \$370,000 和 \$450,000 之间的概率是多少？[3 分]

paras.en: (iii) The State Government of Victoria wants to know the range of mortgage sizes fall in between the lower and upper 10% of the mortgage sizes. Calculate the lower and upper limits of the range. [4 marks]
paras.zh: (iii) 维多利亚州政府想知道落在房贷金额最低 10% 和最高 10% 之间的房贷金额范围。计算这个范围的下限和上限。[4 分]

paras.en: (iv) Find the value of d such that the probability between \$385,000 and d will have a probability of 0.4503. In other words, find the value of d such that P(385,000 < X < d) = 0.4503, where X represents the 2018 mortgage sizes in Victoria, Australia. [4 marks]
paras.zh: (iv) 求 d 的值，使得 \$385,000 到 d 之间的概率为 0.4503。换句话说，求 d 使得 P(385,000 < X < d) = 0.4503，其中 X 表示维多利亚州 2018 年的房贷金额。[4 分]

alt.en: The mortgage distribution: mean 409,000, standard deviation 19,500, with the table of the paper.
alt.zh: 房贷分布：均值 409,000，标准差 19,500，附试卷上的那张表。

caption.en: Parts (i) and (ii): drag the edges to 380,000 and to 370,000 and 450,000. Parts (iii) and (iv): “Find x from an area”.

say.en: (i) Convert 380,000 to a $z$: how many standard deviations below the mean.
say.zh: (i) 把 380,000 换成 $z$：比均值低几个标准差。

say.en: The table: negative page, row −1.4, column .09. This is already the area on the left, which is what “below” asks for.
say.zh: 查表：负数那页，行 −1.4、列 .09。这已经是左边的面积，正是“低于”所要的。

say.en: Between = (area left of the upper value) minus (area left of the lower value).
say.zh: 之间 =（上界左边的面积）减去（下界左边的面积）。

say.en: About 96% of mortgages lie between the two.
say.zh: 大约 96% 的房贷落在两者之间。

say.en: (iii) The lower 10% means 0.10 of the area on the left. Search the body of the table: the closest entry to 0.10 is 0.1003, at $z = -1.28$.
say.zh: (iii) 最低的 10% 就是左边的面积为 0.10。在表的正文里找：最接近 0.10 的是 0.1003，对应 $z = -1.28$。

say.en: Turn $z$ back into dollars: mean plus $z$ standard deviations.
say.zh: 把 $z$ 换回美元：均值加上 $z$ 个标准差。

say.en: The upper 10% has 0.90 to its left; by symmetry $z = +1.28$.
Between = left of $d$ minus left of 385,000, so the area left of $d$ is 0.1093 + 0.4503. The table has exactly 0.5596 at $z = 0.15$.

title.en: The full-mark answers, as they are written
title.zh: 满分答案，写在卷子上是这样
第 5 题 (i) 到 (iv)，满分写法

body.en: Write the conversion to $z$ with the numbers in it, the table value you read, and the final answer in the original units. Marks go for each of the three, so a wrong table read costs one mark, not all of them.
body.zh: 写出代入数字的 $z$ 换算、你查到的表值，以及用原单位表示的最终答案。三者各有分，所以查错一个表值只丢一分，不会全丢。

prompt.en: Hourly pay of financial managers is normal with mean \$32.62 and standard deviation \$2.32. What is the probability that a manager earns **between \$30 and \$35**? (Four decimals; round each $z$ to two decimals first.)
prompt.zh: 财务经理的时薪服从正态分布，均值 \$32.62，标准差 \$2.32。一位经理时薪**在 \$30 到 \$35 之间**的概率是多少？（四位小数；每个 $z$ 先取两位小数。）

body.en: A normal probability is always an area. The height of the curve at a point is not a probability.
body.zh: 正态概率永远是面积。曲线在一点的高度不是概率。

body.en: The table is the area to the **left**. “Above” and “more than”: $1 -$ table. “Between”: subtract two table values.
body.zh: 表是**左边**的面积。“高于”“超过”：$1 -$ 表值。“之间”：两个表值相减。

body.en: A negative $z$ lives on the negative page: $-1.49$ is row $-1.4$, column .09. Mixing it up with 1.49 gives 0.9319 instead of 0.0681.

prompt.en: A machine fails a test with probability 0.05 each time, independently. In 4 tests, the probability that it fails at least once is:
prompt.zh: 一台机器每次测试独立地以 0.05 的概率不合格。4 次测试里至少不合格一次的概率是：

feedback.en: That adds the chances and double counts the cases where it fails twice or more.
feedback.zh: 那是把概率相加，会把失败两次或更多次的情形重复算。

feedback.en: That is the chance it fails *every* time.
feedback.zh: 那是它*每次*都不合格的概率。

explain.zh: “至少一次”是 1 减去“一次也没有”。

prompt.en: The paper’s formula sheet gives the sample variance. What does it divide the sum of squared deviations by?
prompt.zh: 试卷的公式表给出了样本方差。它把偏差平方和除以什么？

feedback.en: That is for a whole population.
